t.SODIUM_HYALURONATE.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.SODIUM_HYALURONATE.eff.0: No known side effect in normal use (CIR, 2009; up to 2%).
t.SODIUM_HYALURONATE.summary: The sodium salt of hyaluronic acid; a humectant.
t.SODIUM_HYALURONATE.what: Binds water and keeps moisture on the skin surface.
